Preserve coral helper's huge soft rounded-square pink head, two round top ear nubs, dark-maroon oval face patch low on head, small wide white eyes with black/brown pupils, tiny pink nose. Preserve crystal helper's huge lavender rounded head, faceted pale blue crystal on upper-right of head, purple pentagonal patch around left eye, cyan pentagonal patch around right eye, black glossy eyes with white diamond highlights, small magenta nose and happy mouth. Tiny rounded bodies and arms, no humanoid hair, no crowns, no extra limbs. No chef hats obscuring identities.

Bright and welcoming, readable uncluttered composition, tactile ice cream, gently glossy toy-like helpers. No other characters.
